description:
In the prestigious Lee family, only Alphas are ever born—and 8-year-old Lee Mun-Ho is no exception. So when he's suddenly married off to Han Wol-Ah, the elegant 16-year-old heir of the famous Omega Han family, it's the talk of the town. At the wedding, poor Mun-Ho is a bundle of nerves… until Wol-Ah gently calms him down. Cue instant puppy-love. But the moment the ceremony ends? Prince Charming disappears. “Massage my legs,” Wol-Ah commands. And just like that, Mun-Ho’s honeymoon becomes housework. From that day on, Wol-Ah treats him less like a groom and more like a very tiny servant. Years pass in comedic misery until finally—Mun-Ho’s coming-of-age ceremony arrives. He’s taller. Stronger. Still hopelessly in love. But now the tables might just turn...

Will Mun-Ho get revenge? Or will he fall even harder for the bossy Omega who stole his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)
